analyst.summary: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre is a well-run, high-margin diagnostics chain that continues to grow test volumes and shift its mix toward higher-value specialised testing, supported by a funded expansion plan for new labs and collection centres. The business quality is genuinely excellent, but the stock is priced very richly, leaving little room for any slowdown. We rate this a Hold: strong execution, but the valuation already assumes a long, uninterrupted growth runway.
